session.prompt_summary: Why is the websocket reconnect loop hammering the server?

messages.content: Why is the websocket reconnect loop hammering the server?
The reconnect interval is a flat 50ms with no backoff — every dropped connection turns into a tight retry loop.
Right, cap it with exponential backoff in ws/reconnect.ts and add the jitter test to ws/reconnect.test.ts.
